description:
Spring Boot auto-configuration wiring bootstrap-axon-postgres into a
        working EventStorageEngine bean, with independently configurable
        DataSource resolution for the event store. Named
        opendcb-axon-spring-boot-starter (not spring-boot-starter-*) per
        Spring Boot's own third-party starter naming convention. The only
        module in this toolkit that depends on Spring; the root parent pom
        stays Spring-free.
